Base-N Arithmetic

Add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers in any base from 2 to 36 with exact BigInt math and a full conversion breakdown.

Steps

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a base between 2 and 36.
  2. Type the two operands using valid digits for that base (0-9 then A-Z).
  3. Choose +, −, × or ÷ and press Calculate.
  4. Read the result in your base plus the decimal cross-check and conversion steps.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which digits are allowed in each base?

Digits go 0–9 then letters A–Z. Base 16 allows 0–9 and A–F; base 36 allows all digits and letters. The tool validates every character before computing.

Why can division produce a fraction?

Integer division in another base still follows the same rules: a ÷ b gives a quotient and remainder. Both are converted back to your base so you can verify the result.

Is the arithmetic exact for huge numbers?

Yes — operands are converted with BigInt, so arbitrarily long digit strings compute exactly with no floating-point rounding.
